name: FACTurk
description: False and misleading information has become a major societal challenge, increasing the importance of fact-checking activities. In this study, we present FACTurk, a dataset comprising 15,766 fact-checking reports published between 2009 and 2026 and collected from six Turkish fact-checking platforms. In addition, a range of statistical analyses has been conducted on the dataset, and the distribution of persons and organisations mentioned in the claims has been examined using a named entity recognition model. The dataset is intended to support future research aimed at understanding the dynamics of disinformation in Türkiye and advancing fact-checking practices. FACTurk and its accompanying source code have been made publicly available as open source at https://github.com/altuncu/FACTurk.
